description: A small, chilly bathroom dominated by a large wooden bathtub, its surface damp and worn. On a nearby shelf, neatly folded towels sit beside a collection of homemade soaps, their scents faint in the cold air. A small, intricately carved wooden boat rests on the windowsill, a whimsical touch against the frost-covered glass. A single candle gutter on the edge of the tub, casting flickering shadows across the tiled floor.

exits.description: A wooden door that has a small sigh of Bath on it.

items.name: Large Wooden Bathtub
items.description: A large wooden bathtub, its surface damp and worn. The water inside is still and cold.

items.name: Homemade Soap Bar
items.description: A fragrant bar of homemade soap, shaped into a delicate flower. The scent of lavender and chamomile is faint but pleasant.

items.name: Wooden Toy Boat
items.description: A small, intricately carved wooden boat resting on the windowsill. Its paint is faded but the craftsmanship is evident.

name: Bathroom
